invariant: UNKNOWN prior context remains UNKNOWN. Missing information cannot be converted into affirmative evidence of subject fault or agent lawfulness, and likewise cannot by itself establish unlawful force.
purpose: Promote scattered federal-force incident leads into a governed review inventory while preserving incident-specific primary-source acquisition requirements. Every incident in this batch is only a candidate for review; no candidate is pre-classified as confirming, disconfirming, supporting, contradicting, pattern-bearing, exculpatory, or inculpatory.
classification_rule: Discovery and admission to this batch do not assign an evidentiary direction. Directional relationships, if any, may be derived only after the incident evidence is acquired and reviewed.

review_dimensions: Preserve directly observable facts separately from provenance/legal-finality caveats.
Record which pre-event facts are known and which remain UNKNOWN.
Preserve official statements, witness accounts, analyst/model responses, later evidence, and outcomes as separate evidence objects.
Record any subject-fault, threat, resistance, criminality, agent-lawfulness, or self-defense proposition and the evidence cited for it.
Record correction count/latency when a model response is part of the incident evidence.
Map relationships among initial statements, later bodycam, court, forensic, medical, investigative, and supervisory evidence only after those objects are acquired.
Do not assign a candidate to a confirming or disconfirming class.
